name.sw: Mama Mjamzito

who.en:
For a woman who is pregnant, from her first antenatal visit to birth. The box arrives three times, once at the start of each trimester, each carrying three months of goods. Delivering once a trimester instead of monthly is what lets the box pay its own packing and delivery (founder decision D-12, 10 Nov 2026).

It is built on the WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience (2016): at least eight antenatal contacts; daily iron and folic acid; calcium where diets are low in calcium; ginger for nausea; preventive malaria treatment and a treated net; and advice on healthy eating and staying active. The 2016 guideline does not recommend multiple-micronutrient, vitamin B6, or vitamin C and E supplements for pregnant women, so none is sent. Tanzania’s Ministry of Health adopted the eight-contact model in its 2018 antenatal care guidelines (a draft is hosted by WHO Afro; not opened here).

Afya does not replace the clinic. The box brings the everyday goods a pregnancy needs: protection from malaria and infection, comfort for changing skin and gums, and in the third trimester a complete hospital bag. Medicines and supplements come from the licensed partner pharmacy, only as the clinic prescribes.
who.sw:
Kwa mwanamke mjamzito, tangu kliniki yake ya kwanza ya ujauzito hadi kujifungua. Boksi linakuja mara tatu, mwanzoni mwa kila kipindi cha miezi mitatu, kila moja likiwa na bidhaa za miezi mitatu. Kuleta boksi mara moja kila miezi mitatu badala ya kila mwezi ndiko kunakoliwezesha boksi kulipia gharama zake za kufunga na kusafirisha (uamuzi wa mwanzilishi D-12, 10 Nov 2026).

Limejengwa juu ya mapendekezo ya WHO kuhusu huduma ya ujauzito kwa uzoefu chanya wa ujauzito (2016): angalau mahudhurio manane ya kliniki ya ujauzito; madini ya chuma na foliki kila siku; kalsiamu pale vyakula vina kalsiamu kidogo; tangawizi kwa kichefuchefu; dawa ya kuzuia malaria na chandarua chenye dawa; na ushauri wa kula vizuri na kufanya mazoezi. Mwongozo wa 2016 haushauri virutubisho mchanganyiko, vitamini B6 wala vitamini C na E kwa wajawazito, hivyo hakuna kinachotumwa. Wizara ya Afya ya Tanzania ilipitisha mfumo wa mahudhurio manane katika miongozo yake ya huduma ya ujauzito ya mwaka 2018 (rasimu inapatikana WHO Afro; haikufunguliwa hapa).

Afya haichukui nafasi ya kliniki. Boksi linaleta bidhaa za kila siku ambazo ujauzito unahitaji: kinga dhidi ya malaria na maambukizi, faraja kwa ngozi na fizi zinazobadilika, na katika miezi mitatu ya mwisho begi kamili la hospitali. Dawa na virutubisho vinatoka kwa famasia mshirika yenye leseni, kama kliniki inavyoandika tu.

clinic_line.en: Your clinic decides your tests, your antenatal visits and any medicine or supplement, including iron, folic acid and calcium, and their doses. Afya does not sell medicines: the licensed partner pharmacy supplies them only on the clinic’s prescription. If anything worries you, go to your clinic straight away; do not wait for the next box.
clinic_line.sw: Kliniki yako ndiyo inayoamua vipimo vyako, mahudhurio yako ya kliniki ya ujauzito na dawa au virutubisho vyovyote, ikiwemo madini ya chuma, foliki na kalsiamu, pamoja na dozi zake. Afya haiuzi dawa: famasia mshirika yenye leseni huzitoa tu kwa maelekezo ya kliniki. Ukiona dalili yoyote inayokutia wasiwasi, nenda kliniki yako mara moja; usisubiri boksi lijalo.

name.en: Iron and folic acid, one a day (partner pharmacy)
name.sw: Madini ya chuma na foliki, kidonge kimoja kwa siku (famasia mshirika)

why.en: WHO (2016, A.2.1) recommends daily oral iron (30–60 mg elemental iron) with 400 µg folic acid through pregnancy, to prevent maternal anaemia, puerperal sepsis, low birth weight and preterm birth. Folic acid should start as early as possible. The tablets are free at public antenatal clinics; the partner pharmacy supplies them only when the clinic prescribes them and is out of stock. Afya does not sell or price them.
why.sw: WHO (2016, A.2.1) inashauri madini ya chuma (mg 30–60) pamoja na foliki mikrogramu 400 kila siku katika ujauzito wote, ili kuzuia upungufu wa damu, maambukizi baada ya kujifungua, uzito mdogo wa kuzaliwa na kuzaliwa kabla ya wakati. Foliki ianze mapema iwezekanavyo. Vidonge hivi ni bure katika kliniki za umma; famasia mshirika huvitoa tu kliniki ikiviandika na ikikosa. Afya haiuzi wala haiweki bei yake.

name.sw: Chai ya tangawizi kwa kichefuchefu cha asubuhi

why.en: Nausea affects most women in early pregnancy. WHO (2016, D.1) recommends ginger, chamomile, vitamin B6 and/or acupuncture for relief, based on the woman’s preference. Small, frequent cups of ginger tea are cheap and easy to keep down. Severe vomiting is a reason to go to the clinic.
why.sw: Kichefuchefu huwapata wanawake wengi mwanzoni mwa ujauzito. WHO (2016, D.1) inashauri tangawizi, kamomile, vitamini B6 na/au acupuncture kupunguza tatizo hili, kulingana na anachopendelea mama. Vikombe vidogo vya chai ya tangawizi mara kwa mara ni nafuu na hukaa tumboni kwa urahisi. Kutapika sana ni sababu ya kwenda kliniki.

items.qty_formula: 1 cup a day × 13 weeks ≈ 90 bags (first trimester only).

name.sw: Dawa ya kufukuza mbu

why.en: Malaria in pregnancy causes maternal anaemia, low birth weight and stillbirth. A repellent covers the evening hours outdoors before the woman is under her net. It adds to, and never replaces, the clinic’s preventive malaria treatment (IPTp, WHO 2016 C.6) and the treated net. Use only products whose label states the active ingredient and that they may be used in pregnancy.
why.sw: Malaria wakati wa ujauzito husababisha upungufu wa damu kwa mama, uzito mdogo wa mtoto na mtoto kuzaliwa amekufa. Dawa ya kufukuza mbu hulinda saa za jioni nje kabla mama hajaingia kwenye chandarua. Inaongeza, na kamwe haichukui nafasi ya, dawa ya kliniki ya kuzuia malaria (IPTp, WHO 2016 C.6) na chandarua chenye dawa. Tumia tu bidhaa ambazo lebo yake inataja kiambato hai na kwamba inafaa wakati wa ujauzito.

items.qty_formula: 1 roll-on or spray a month × 3 months = 3.

name.sw: Chandarua chenye dawa cha muda mrefu

why.en: Sleeping under an insecticide-treated net protects the mother now and the newborn later, who will sleep in the parents’ bed or beside it. Most nets sold in Tanzanian shops are untreated, so the box brings one WHO-prequalified long-lasting treated net, once, in the first trimester box.
why.sw: Kulala chini ya chandarua chenye dawa humlinda mama sasa na mtoto mchanga baadaye, atakayelala kitandani mwa wazazi au pembeni yake. Vyandarua vingi vinavyouzwa madukani Tanzania havina dawa, hivyo boksi linaleta chandarua kimoja cha muda mrefu chenye dawa, kilichoidhinishwa na WHO, mara moja tu, kwenye boksi la miezi mitatu ya kwanza.

qty.sw: Chandarua 1 (boksi la miezi mitatu ya kwanza tu)

items.qty_formula: 1 net for the parents’ bed; lasts about 3 years.

name.sw: Sabuni ya kunawa mikono nyumbani

why.en: Handwashing with soap is the cheapest infection control a household has: community handwashing promotion cuts child diarrhoea by about 30% (Cochrane). The habit set in pregnancy protects the newborn: wash after the toilet, before food and, later, after every nappy and before every feed.
why.sw: Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni ndiyo kinga ya maambukizi ya bei nafuu zaidi kwa kaya: kuhamasisha unawaji wa mikono hupunguza kuharisha kwa watoto kwa takriban asilimia 30 (Cochrane). Tabia inayojengwa wakati wa ujauzito humlinda mtoto mchanga: nawa baada ya choo, kabla ya chakula na, baadaye, baada ya kila nepi na kabla ya kila kunyonyesha.

qty.en: About 1,050 g of bar soap (six 175 g bars)
qty.sw: Takriban gramu 1,050 za sabuni ya kipande (vipande sita vya gramu 175)

items.qty_formula: 2 bars of about 175 g a month × 3 months = 6 bars ≈ 1,050 g.

name.sw: Dawa ya kutibu maji ya kunywa

why.en: Tap and well water in Dar es Salaam is not reliably safe, and diarrhoea in pregnancy dehydrates the mother. Chlorinating drinking water at home cuts diarrhoea by about a quarter (Cochrane). Boiling is a good alternative where fuel allows.
why.sw: Maji ya bomba na ya kisima Dar es Salaam si salama kila wakati, na kuharisha wakati wa ujauzito humkausha mama maji mwilini. Kuweka klorini kwenye maji ya kunywa nyumbani hupunguza kuharisha kwa takriban robo (Cochrane). Kuchemsha maji ni njia nzuri mbadala pale nishati inaporuhusu.

items.qty_formula: about 10 L of drinking and cooking water a day × 91 days ≈ 910 L → one 150 ml WaterGuard bottle (≈1,000 L). units = litres treated.

name.en: Gentle intimate wash, external use only
name.sw: Sabuni laini ya sehemu za siri, matumizi ya nje tu

why.en: The vagina cleans itself. Wash only the outside, once a day, with water and a mild unperfumed cleanser; never douche. Perfumed soaps and gels irritate, which is why a gentle, pH-balanced wash is offered. Plain water is also enough.
why.sw: Uke hujisafisha wenyewe. Osha sehemu ya nje tu, mara moja kwa siku, kwa maji na sabuni laini isiyo na manukato; usisafishe ndani ya uke kamwe. Sabuni na jeli zenye manukato huwasha, ndiyo sababu sabuni laini yenye pH sawia inatolewa. Maji safi peke yake pia yanatosha.

items.qty_formula: 2–3 ml once a day × 91 days ≈ 230 ml → one 250 ml bottle.

name.en: Calcium, from week 20 (partner pharmacy, if the clinic prescribes it)
name.sw: Kalsiamu, kuanzia wiki ya 20 (famasia mshirika, kliniki ikiandika)

why.en: Pre-eclampsia (dangerously high blood pressure in pregnancy) is a leading cause of maternal death. Where diets are low in calcium, WHO (2016, A.3; revalidated 2018) recommends 1.5–2.0 g elemental calcium a day from 20 weeks to birth. A 2024 trial in Dar es Salaam and India found 500 mg a day non-inferior against pre-eclampsia, but the dose is the clinic’s decision. Calcium is taken at a different meal from iron. Sold by the partner pharmacy; not priced in the box.
why.sw: Priklampsia (shinikizo la damu la hatari wakati wa ujauzito) ni miongoni mwa visababishi vikuu vya vifo vya akina mama. Pale vyakula vina kalsiamu kidogo, WHO (2016, A.3; ilithibitishwa tena 2018) inashauri gramu 1.5–2.0 za kalsiamu kila siku kuanzia wiki ya 20 hadi kujifungua. Utafiti wa mwaka 2024 Dar es Salaam na India ulionyesha mg 500 kwa siku zinafaa sawa dhidi ya priklampsia, lakini kipimo ni uamuzi wa kliniki. Kalsiamu humezwa mlo tofauti na madini ya chuma. Inauzwa na famasia mshirika; haiwekewi bei kwenye boksi.

items.qty_formula: units 0: dose set by the clinic. Covers weeks 20–27 (56 days). WHO: 1.5–2.0 g elemental calcium a day where diets are low in calcium; Dar es Salaam trial: 500 mg a day.

name.sw: Losheni ya mwili kwa ngozi inayotanuka

why.en: From the second trimester the skin of the belly, breasts and thighs stretches and often itches. A rich lotion eases dryness. No cream or oil has been shown to prevent stretch marks, and Afya makes no such claim. Intense itching, especially of the palms and soles, is a reason to tell the clinic.
why.sw: Kuanzia miezi mitatu ya pili ngozi ya tumbo, matiti na mapaja hutanuka na mara nyingi huwasha. Losheni nzito hupunguza ukavu. Hakuna krimu wala mafuta yaliyothibitishwa kuzuia michirizi, na Afya haitoi dai hilo. Muwasho mkali, hasa wa viganja na nyayo, ni sababu ya kuiambia kliniki.

name.en: Iron and folic acid, one a day (partner pharmacy)
name.sw: Madini ya chuma na foliki, kidonge kimoja kwa siku (famasia mshirika)

why.en: WHO (2016, A.2.1) recommends daily oral iron (30–60 mg elemental iron) with 400 µg folic acid through pregnancy, to prevent maternal anaemia, puerperal sepsis, low birth weight and preterm birth. Folic acid should start as early as possible. The tablets are free at public antenatal clinics; the partner pharmacy supplies them only when the clinic prescribes them and is out of stock. Afya does not sell or price them.
why.sw: WHO (2016, A.2.1) inashauri madini ya chuma (mg 30–60) pamoja na foliki mikrogramu 400 kila siku katika ujauzito wote, ili kuzuia upungufu wa damu, maambukizi baada ya kujifungua, uzito mdogo wa kuzaliwa na kuzaliwa kabla ya wakati. Foliki ianze mapema iwezekanavyo. Vidonge hivi ni bure katika kliniki za umma; famasia mshirika huvitoa tu kliniki ikiviandika na ikikosa. Afya haiuzi wala haiweki bei yake.

name.en: Calcium, from week 20 (partner pharmacy, if the clinic prescribes it)
name.sw: Kalsiamu, kuanzia wiki ya 20 (famasia mshirika, kliniki ikiandika)

why.en: Pre-eclampsia (dangerously high blood pressure in pregnancy) is a leading cause of maternal death. Where diets are low in calcium, WHO (2016, A.3; revalidated 2018) recommends 1.5–2.0 g elemental calcium a day from 20 weeks to birth. A 2024 trial in Dar es Salaam and India found 500 mg a day non-inferior against pre-eclampsia, but the dose is the clinic’s decision. Calcium is taken at a different meal from iron. Sold by the partner pharmacy; not priced in the box.
why.sw: Priklampsia (shinikizo la damu la hatari wakati wa ujauzito) ni miongoni mwa visababishi vikuu vya vifo vya akina mama. Pale vyakula vina kalsiamu kidogo, WHO (2016, A.3; ilithibitishwa tena 2018) inashauri gramu 1.5–2.0 za kalsiamu kila siku kuanzia wiki ya 20 hadi kujifungua. Utafiti wa mwaka 2024 Dar es Salaam na India ulionyesha mg 500 kwa siku zinafaa sawa dhidi ya priklampsia, lakini kipimo ni uamuzi wa kliniki. Kalsiamu humezwa mlo tofauti na madini ya chuma. Inauzwa na famasia mshirika; haiwekewi bei kwenye boksi.

items.qty_formula: units 0: dose set by the clinic. Covers weeks 28–40 (91 days). WHO: 1.5–2.0 g elemental calcium a day where diets are low in calcium; Dar es Salaam trial: 500 mg a day.

name.sw: Dawa ya kufukuza mbu

why.en: Malaria in pregnancy causes maternal anaemia, low birth weight and stillbirth. A repellent covers the evening hours outdoors before the woman is under her net. It adds to, and never replaces, the clinic’s preventive malaria treatment (IPTp, WHO 2016 C.6) and the treated net. Use only products whose label states the active ingredient and that they may be used in pregnancy.
why.sw: Malaria wakati wa ujauzito husababisha upungufu wa damu kwa mama, uzito mdogo wa mtoto na mtoto kuzaliwa amekufa. Dawa ya kufukuza mbu hulinda saa za jioni nje kabla mama hajaingia kwenye chandarua. Inaongeza, na kamwe haichukui nafasi ya, dawa ya kliniki ya kuzuia malaria (IPTp, WHO 2016 C.6) na chandarua chenye dawa. Tumia tu bidhaa ambazo lebo yake inataja kiambato hai na kwamba inafaa wakati wa ujauzito.

items.qty_formula: 1 roll-on or spray a month × 3 months = 3.

name.sw: Sabuni ya kunawa mikono nyumbani

why.en: Handwashing with soap is the cheapest infection control a household has: community handwashing promotion cuts child diarrhoea by about 30% (Cochrane). The habit set in pregnancy protects the newborn: wash after the toilet, before food and, later, after every nappy and before every feed.
why.sw: Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni ndiyo kinga ya maambukizi ya bei nafuu zaidi kwa kaya: kuhamasisha unawaji wa mikono hupunguza kuharisha kwa watoto kwa takriban asilimia 30 (Cochrane). Tabia inayojengwa wakati wa ujauzito humlinda mtoto mchanga: nawa baada ya choo, kabla ya chakula na, baadaye, baada ya kila nepi na kabla ya kila kunyonyesha.

qty.en: About 1,050 g of bar soap (six 175 g bars)
qty.sw: Takriban gramu 1,050 za sabuni ya kipande (vipande sita vya gramu 175)

items.qty_formula: 2 bars of about 175 g a month × 3 months = 6 bars ≈ 1,050 g.

name.sw: Dawa ya kutibu maji ya kunywa

why.en: Tap and well water in Dar es Salaam is not reliably safe, and diarrhoea in pregnancy dehydrates the mother. Chlorinating drinking water at home cuts diarrhoea by about a quarter (Cochrane). Boiling is a good alternative where fuel allows.
why.sw: Maji ya bomba na ya kisima Dar es Salaam si salama kila wakati, na kuharisha wakati wa ujauzito humkausha mama maji mwilini. Kuweka klorini kwenye maji ya kunywa nyumbani hupunguza kuharisha kwa takriban robo (Cochrane). Kuchemsha maji ni njia nzuri mbadala pale nishati inaporuhusu.

why.en: Skin is often drier and more sensitive in pregnancy. A mild, creamy wash every day is part of the mother’s own care; strongly perfumed soaps are the commonest irritant.

name.sw: Losheni ya mwili kwa ngozi inayotanuka

why.en: From the second trimester the skin of the belly, breasts and thighs stretches and often itches. A rich lotion eases dryness. No cream or oil has been shown to prevent stretch marks, and Afya makes no such claim. Intense itching, especially of the palms and soles, is a reason to tell the clinic.
why.sw: Kuanzia miezi mitatu ya pili ngozi ya tumbo, matiti na mapaja hutanuka na mara nyingi huwasha. Losheni nzito hupunguza ukavu. Hakuna krimu wala mafuta yaliyothibitishwa kuzuia michirizi, na Afya haitoi dai hilo. Muwasho mkali, hasa wa viganja na nyayo, ni sababu ya kuiambia kliniki.

tiers.en: Regular = the core box with default brands. Premium = core + the premium item of that trimester. Luxury = core + the luxury item. The luxury item is priced as its own line at shelf price, outside the saving (D4).
tiers.sw: Kawaida = boksi la msingi lenye chapa za msingi. Premium = boksi la msingi + bidhaa ya premium ya kipindi hicho. Anasa = boksi la msingi + bidhaa ya anasa. Bidhaa ya anasa ina bei yake peke yake kwa bei ya rafu, nje ya punguzo (D4).

services_note.en: antenatal-support: in-store blood pressure, weight and danger-sign check, and reminders for the 8 WHO antenatal contacts, IPTp and tetanus vaccine; store and public services, fee 0. midwife-home-visit: optional add-on in the third trimester (birth preparedness and breastfeeding preparation); partner price not yet quoted (R7), so not in the box price.
services_note.sw: antenatal-support: kupima shinikizo la damu, uzito na dalili za hatari dukani, na vikumbusho vya mahudhurio 8 ya WHO ya kliniki ya ujauzito, IPTp na chanjo ya pepopunda; huduma za duka na za umma, ada 0. midwife-home-visit: huduma ya hiari katika miezi mitatu ya mwisho (maandalizi ya kujifungua na ya kunyonyesha); bei ya mshirika bado haijatolewa (R7), hivyo haimo kwenye bei ya boksi.

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the trimester box goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing (M 5,000, L 6,500) and one delivery 3,500 included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 shares 78% brand / 72% pharm / 50% own) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0.
pricing_rule.note: Price is per trimester box. Medicines and the luxury line are outside the shelf value.
